sentences.cn_text: 历史上首次，居住在城镇的人口超过了居住在乡村的人口。
sentences.en_text: For the first time in history more people live in towns than in the country.

sentences.cn_text: 在英国，这产生了一个奇特的结果。
sentences.en_text: In Britain this has had a curious result.

sentences.cn_text: 尽管民意调查显示，英国人将「乡村」与王室、莎士比亚和国家医疗服务体系并列为让他们最为国家自豪的象征，但这一情感在政治上却得不到多少支持。
sentences.en_text: While polls show Britons rate “the countryside” alongside the royal family, Shakespeare and the National Health Service (NHS) as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.

sentences.cn_text: 一个世纪前，奥克塔维娅·希尔创立国家信托基金，并非为了拯救气派的宅邸，而是为了「永远为所有人保存自然美景」。
sentences.en_text: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save “the beauty of natural places for everyone forever.”

sentences.cn_text: 这一举措的具体目的是为城市居民提供休闲空间，让他们能够体验「清新的空气」。
sentences.en_text: It was specifically to provide city dwellers with spaces for leisure where they could experience “a refreshing air.”

sentences.cn_text: 希尔的推动后来促成了国家公园和绿化带的建立。
sentences.en_text: Hill’s pressure later led to the creation of national parks and green belts.

sentences.cn_text: 乡村不可再生，而每年混凝土都在吞噬更多乡村土地。
sentences.en_text: They don’t make countryside any more, and every year concrete consumes more of it.

sentences.cn_text: 乡村需要持续的守护。
sentences.en_text: It needs constant guardianship.

sentences.cn_text: 在下一次选举中，各大政党似乎都不太可能支持这一主张。
sentences.en_text: At the next election none of the big parties seem likely to endorse this sentiment.

sentences.cn_text: 保守党的规划改革明确将乡村发展置于保护之上，甚至授权在当地人可能反对的情况下进行「规划外」建设。
sentences.en_text: The Conservatives’ planning reform explicitly gives rural development priority over conservation, even authorising “off-plan” building where local people might object.

sentences.cn_text: 可持续发展的概念已被定义为有利可图的发展。
sentences.en_text: The concept of sustainable development has been defined as profitable.

sentences.cn_text: 工党同样希望在地方议会反对开发的地区取消地方规划。
sentences.en_text: Labour likewise wants to discontinue local planning where councils oppose development.

sentences.cn_text: 自由民主党则保持沉默。
sentences.en_text: The Liberal Democrats are silent.

sentences.cn_text: 只有英国独立党察觉到机会，站在那些呼吁更审慎使用绿地的人一边。
sentences.en_text: Only Ukip, sensing its chance, has sided with those pleading for a more considered approach to using green land.

sentences.cn_text: 该党发起的保护英格兰乡村运动使许多地方保守党组织感到恐慌。
sentences.en_text: Its Campaign to Protect Rural England struck terror into many local Conservative parties.

sentences.cn_text: 建造新住宅、工厂和办公楼的合理地点是在人口所在之处，即基础设施已经到位的城市和城镇。
sentences.en_text: The sensible place to build new houses, factories and offices is where people are, in cities and towns where infrastructure is in place.

sentences.cn_text: 伦敦地产代理商斯特林·阿克罗伊德最近仅在伦敦地区就确定了足以建造五十万套住房的地块，且不会侵占绿化带。
sentences.en_text: The London agents Stirling Ackroyd recently identified enough sites for half a million houses in the London area alone, with no intrusion on green belt.

sentences.cn_text: 伦敦的情况如此，外省的情况更是如此。
sentences.en_text: What is true of London is even truer of the provinces.

sentences.cn_text: 认为「住房危机」等于「草地被混凝土覆盖」的观点纯属游说宣传。
sentences.en_text: The idea that “housing crisis” equals “concreted meadows” is pure lobby talk.

sentences.cn_text: 问题不在于是否需要更多住房，而在于一如既往的问题——在哪里建造它们。
sentences.en_text: The issue is not the need for more houses but, as always, where to put them.

sentences.cn_text: 在游说压力下,乔治·奥斯本倾向于乡村新建项目而非城市改造和更新。
sentences.en_text: Under lobby pressure, George Osborne favours rural new-build against urban renovation and renewal.

sentences.cn_text: 他倾向于城外购物中心而非繁华商业街。
sentences.en_text: He favours out-of-town shopping sites against high streets.

sentences.cn_text: 这并非自由市场,而是一个有偏向性的市场。
sentences.en_text: This is not a free market but a biased one.

sentences.cn_text: 乡村城镇和村庄一直在发展,也将继续发展。
sentences.en_text: Rural towns and villages have grown and will always grow.

sentences.cn_text: 当建设活动局限于边缘地带并尊重其特色时,它们发展得最好。
sentences.en_text: They do so best where building sticks to their edges and respects their character.

sentences.cn_text: 我们不会破坏城市保护区。
sentences.en_text: We do not ruin urban conservation areas.

sentences.cn_text: 为何要破坏乡村保护区?
sentences.en_text: Why ruin rural ones?

sentences.cn_text: 发展应当规划进行,而非任其泛滥。
sentences.en_text: Development should be planned, not let rip.

sentences.cn_text: 仅次于荷兰,英国是欧洲人口最稠密的国家。
sentences.en_text: After the Netherlands, Britain is Europe’s most crowded country.

sentences.cn_text: 半个世纪的城乡规划使英国得以保持令人羡慕的乡村协调性,同时仍允许低密度的城市居住模式。
sentences.en_text: Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living.

sentences.cn_text: 反面例子不容置疑——葡萄牙南部、西班牙或爱尔兰遭到破坏的景观。
sentences.en_text: There is no doubt of the alternative — the corrupted landscapes of southern Portugal, Spain or Ireland.

sentences.cn_text: 避免而非推动这种情况,应当成为政治光谱左右两翼的共同立场。
sentences.en_text: Avoiding this rather than promoting it should unite the left and right of the political spectrum.

sentences.cn_text: 英国公众对乡村的情感____
sentences.en_text: Britain’s public sentiment about the countryside ____

sentences.cn_text: 直到莎士比亚时代才开始出现。
sentences.en_text: didn’t start till the Shakespearean age.

sentences.cn_text: 给国家医疗服务体系带来了诸多益处。
sentences.en_text: has brought much benefit to the NHS.

sentences.cn_text: 得到了王室的全力支持。
sentences.en_text: is fully backed by the royal family.

sentences.cn_text: 在政治上未得到充分体现。
sentences.en_text: is not well reflected in politics.

sentences.en_text: Which of the following can be inferred from Paragraph 3?

sentences.cn_text: 工党因反对开发而遭到抨击。
sentences.en_text: Labour is under attack for opposing development.

sentences.cn_text: 保守党可能会放弃「规划外」建设。
sentences.en_text: The Conservatives may abandon “off-plan” building.

sentences.cn_text: 自由民主党正在丧失政治影响力。
sentences.en_text: The Liberal Democrats are losing political influence.

sentences.cn_text: 英国独立党可能因支持乡村保护而获益。
sentences.en_text: Ukip may gain from its support for rural conservation.

sentences.cn_text: 彰显了他抵制游说压力的坚定立场。
sentences.en_text: highlights his firm stand against lobby pressure.

sentences.cn_text: 表明他无视乡村地区的特色。
sentences.en_text: shows his disregard for the character of rural areas.

sentences.cn_text: 强调了缓解住房危机的必要性。
sentences.en_text: stresses the necessity of easing the housing crisis.

sentences.cn_text: 揭示了对城市地区的强烈偏见。

sentences.en_text: the size of population in Britain.

sentences.en_text: the political life in today’s Britain.

sentences.en_text: the enviable urban lifestyle in Britain.

sentences.en_text: the town-and-country planning in Britain.
